row.notes: tyre allocation component virtual (vtable slot 0x14567a8b8), run at each session start: session = (component+0x270)->vtbl[+0xa8]() (+0x08 id), weekend = (component+0x270)->vtbl[+0x98](); for every car allocation (entries component+0x2b0..+0x2b8, 16 bytes, allocation at +8) restores each set's saved wear unless 0x1484f4c20 (via +0x2f8) returns non-zero or the +0x318 lookup hits (the restore copies savedDamage bit1 into bit0), then by session id hands sets back (0x142e8e170 most-worn practice-tagged sets, 0x142e8e970 Q3-tagged ones when the qualifying format is not full) and sets allocation+0xe8 (dirty). Allocation: five compound vectors {begin +0x20, end +0x28} every 0x28 from +0x10, count +0xd8; sets 0x6c bytes: +0x00 recommended session tag (0 = any), +0x09 flags (bit0 damaged, bit1 savedDamage, bit2 mandatory, bit3 handed back, bit4 usedOutsideGarage; serialiser 0x142e88c30), wear floats +0x0c/+0x18/+0x24/+0x30. Usable checks: a tag-0 set is usable in any session; the mode-0 check 0x142e88730 has no case for shootout sessions 10..14 with tagged sets, while the mode-1 check 0x142e88630 accepts tags 10..14 in sessions 10..14 when the tag equals the session or the session is 13 or 14. Raised by native-1990 for the F1 1990 Friday qualifying tyres; corrected after V0967

Session id = vtbl[+0xa8]()+8 and weekend = vtbl[+0x98]() on component+0x270; the loop over +0x2b0..+0x2b8 (16-byte entries, allocation at +8) copies each set's saved block +0x3c..+0x63 into +0x0c..+0x33 and bit1 into bit0, then switches on the session id. 0x142e8e170(alloc, n) hands back (bit3) the most-worn sets tagged 1/2/3 (tag list 0x1457ef0fc, picker 0x142e8e7d0) until n are handed back, with n taken from the rules mode. 0x142e8e970 marks every tag-7 (Q3) set handed back when 0x140afe570(weekend+0x240, group 1) != 4 (not a multi-session qualifying) and on the eliminated-driver paths. Allocation+0xe8 = 1. The layout (five vectors from +0x10 every 0x28, count +0xd8, 0x6c-byte sets, tag +0x00, wear +0x0c/+0x18/+0x24/+0x30) matches the serialiser 0x142e88c30. Wrong details: (1) flags bit0 is 'damaged' in the serialiser's own log ('recommendedSession damaged savedDamage mandatory handedBack usedOutsideGarage' = +0x00 then bits 0..4), not 'used'; the restore copies savedDamage (bit1) into it. The mode-1 inline rules of 0x142e88630 (0x142e88698..0x142e886bc) accept tags 10..14 in sessions 10..14 when tag == session or the session is 13/14. (3) The wear restore is conditional: it is skipped when 0x1484f4c20 (via +0x2f8) returns non-zero or the +0x318 lookup hits
